description: RED check: aggregate error ratio for the checkout endpoint since a given window start. Verifier-only.

configuration.query: FROM traces-*.otel-* | WHERE span.name == "POST /checkout" AND @timestamp >= ?window_start | STATS total = COUNT(*), errors = COUNT(*) WHERE status.code == "Error" | EVAL error_rate = ROUND(errors::double / total, 4)

window_start.description: Start of the verification window, bound to the executor's receipt applied_at timestamp, not now-minus-N-minutes
